name: youtube-agent-matrix
description: A complete YouTube channel operating system for Claude Code. Sixteen specialized subagents covering channel strategy, health audits, competitor intelligence, research, publishable research reports, ideation, content calendars, hooks and retention-engineered scripts written in the creator's own learned voice, thumbnails, SEO, upload metadata, Shorts, cross-platform repurposing, monetization and analytics — coordinated by an orchestrator with human-approval gates — plus a video editor that turns raw footage into a Final Cut Pro project with cuts, animations, camera moves, sound and music on separate layers. Works for any channel, any niche, any language.
